Container.Name: ado-exporter
Container.Overview: Prometheus exporter for Azure DevOps pipeline/pool metrics and (optionally) GitHub repo activity. Polls each API read-only and exposes the results in Prometheus text format. GitHub metrics are optional - leave GITHUB_OWNER blank and skip the github-token mount to run ADO-only.
Container.Requires: An Azure DevOps PAT with read access to the pipelines/pools you want to monitor. A GitHub token is optional, only needed if you set GITHUB_OWNER.

Config.Name: ado-pat
Config.Description: Read-only bind mount to a file containing your Azure DevOps PAT (do not put the PAT directly in a Variable).

Config.Name: github-token
Config.Description: Optional. Read-only bind mount to a file containing a GitHub token, only used if GITHUB_OWNER is set.

Config.Name: ADO_ORG
Config.Description: Your Azure DevOps org URL, e.g. https://dev.azure.com/your-org

Config.Name: GITHUB_OWNER
Config.Description: Optional. GitHub user/org to pull repo metrics for. Leave blank to disable GitHub metrics entirely.
